column1: # Babi's audience, part II: the Draught of Lemuria, Babi's failing supply, and the search for the lost city.

column3: The Stone of Sages?{pause_20_skippable} A\nstone that grants endless\nlife?{end_wait}
I cannot think of\nanother explanation for\nBabi's long life.{end_wait}
So you know of the\nStone of Sages. I do\nnot possess it.{end_wait}
It is the Draught of\nLemuria that has kept\nme alive.{end_wait}
The Draught of Lemuria?{end_wait}
A rare drink once\nprepared for those who\nlived in Lemuria.{end_wait}
Does drinking it stop\nyou from growing old?{end_wait}
It is more accurate to\nsay it slows the passage\nof age{pause_20_skippable}.{end_wait}
Death still comes to\nthe people of Lemuria...{end_wait}
But only after their\nsenses have dulled over\ncenturies of life.{end_wait}
Do the people of\nLemuria wield Psynergy\nas we do?{end_wait}
You have the draught,\nBabi. That is how you\nhave lived so long.{end_wait}
I used its power to\namass enough wealth\nto rule Tolbi.{end_wait}
What are you suggesting?{end_wait}
What do you hope to\ngain by having everyone\nstudy Alchemy?{end_wait}
I have wondered the\nsame. What does Babi\nhope to gain?{end_wait}
If I had found true\nimmortality, I would\nnot need this research.{end_wait}
I had little of the\ndraught left. Now even\nthat supply is failing.{end_wait}
You saw it in the cave.\nOnly a small amount\nremained.{end_wait}
How long will it last?\nWhat happens when it\nis gone?{end_wait}
It will be gone soon.\nThen my life will end.{end_wait}
Why did you not tell\nus sooner? We must\nreach Lemuria at once.{end_wait}
What do you mean,\nthere is no point?{end_wait}
We cannot find Lemuria.\nIt remains beyond our\nreach.{end_wait}
But you said it lies\nfar out at sea...{end_wait}
Then we must search\nthe ocean until we\nfind it!{end_wait}
I have sent many ships\nout to search for\nLemuria.{end_wait}
I was not here then.\nBut every voyage failed?{end_wait}
I needed more draught,\nbut Lemuria stayed\nhidden from us.{end_wait}
Then why did you\ncollapse in the cave\nif you still had some?{end_wait}
I rationed it too\ncarefully. Too much\ntime passed between doses.{end_wait}
You were trying to\nmake the supply last...{end_wait}
I drove myself to find\nLemuria before the last\nof the draught ran out.{end_wait}
So you summoned us\nbecause you need us\nto find Lemuria?{end_wait}
Precisely. I want you\nto find it for me.{end_wait}
I cannot reach it by\nsea. Perhaps the answer\nlies above the waves.{end_wait}
I can hide it no longer...\nI built Babi Lighthouse\nto search for Lemuria.{end_wait}
What? That is why\nyou raised the lighthouse?{end_wait}
No. There is more\nyou must understand.{end_wait}
A shape stirred\nsoutheast in the sea...{pause_20_skippable}{pause_20_skippable}\nwhere Lemuria should lie.{end_wait}
